note: High-country campground at 9,980 ft in lodgepole pines on the south shore of 100-acre Trumbull Lake, off Virginia Lakes Rd west of Conway Summit; a few sites near the water have partial lake views. Trails lead into the Hoover Wilderness from Virginia Lakes. Bears are active: food goes in the lockers. --Claude
summary: Trumbull Lake (Humboldt-Toiyabe NF): lakeview confirmed (partial views from a few sites, all under canopy ~45-65 m from shore); $34 single / $50 double / $65 triple, $6 extra vehicle; reservable June 26-Sept 7 (2026), first-come shoulders; season early June-early Oct; 30 sites, dirt spurs; phone added; website FS link updated.
